description: DB migrations 13-15 (rewards catalogue+redemptions, milestones, automation_rules) + Rewards feature (API + UI page + nav) + Milestones (API + dashboard widget) + Automation rules (API + settings UI + settings nav). Depends on FEAT-001 (all DB types must already be in database.ts). Independent of FEATs 004-006.
steps:
4. Create API routes for rewards:
  a. src/app/api/pulse/rewards/catalogue/route.ts:
     - GET: returns active reward_catalogue items ordered by points_cost asc. Requires session.
     - POST: requires can(role, 'manage_rewards'). Body: { name, description?, points_cost, image_url? }. Validates name non-empty, points_cost > 0. Inserts and returns { id }.
  b. src/app/api/pulse/rewards/redeem/route.ts (POST):
     - Requires session.
     - Body: { catalogue_item_id }.
     - Fetch catalogue item (must be is_active=true).
     - Fetch user's reward_wallet balance. If balance < points_cost → 400 'Insufficient points'.
     - Insert reward_redemption with status 'pending', points_spent = points_cost.
     - Deduct points: UPDATE reward_wallets SET balance = balance - points_cost WHERE user_id = session.user.id.
     - Insert reward_ledger entry: amount = -points_cost, reason = `Redeemed: ${item.name}`, reference_type = 'redemption', reference_id = redemption.id.
     - Returns { id: redemption.id }.
  c. src/app/api/pulse/rewards/redemptions/[id]/route.ts (PATCH):
     - Requires session + can(role, 'manage_rewards').
     - Body: { status: 'approved'|'fulfilled'|'rejected', notes? }.
     - Updates redemption: status, approved_by = session.user.id, fulfilled_at = now() if status === 'fulfilled', notes.
     - Returns { ok: true }.

5. Create src/features/pulse/rewards/ feature folder:
  a. src/features/pulse/rewards/components/RewardsPage.tsx (server component):
     - getServerSession; redirect to /login if none.
     - Fetch: wallet balance (reward_wallets where user_id), catalogue items (active), user's redemptions (reward_redemptions where user_id, last 10, join catalogue name).
     - If can(role, 'manage_rewards'): also fetch pending redemptions across all users (join users.name, catalogue.name).
     - Render SetPageHeader title='Rewards' icon='solar:gift-broken'
     - Render wallet balance as a StatCard (color=amber, value=balance, title='Your points', icon='solar:star-broken').
     - Render catalogue section: grid of cards (rounded-2xl border, image if image_url else icon placeholder, name, description, points_cost badge, 'Redeem' button).
     - The 'Redeem' button is a RedeemButton client component (separate file) that POSTs to /api/pulse/rewards/redeem.
     - Render 'Your redemptions' section: table of user's redemption history (item name, points, status chip, date).
     - If HR/admin: render 'Pending redemptions' tab section showing pending items with approve/reject buttons (RedemptionActions client component).
  b. src/features/pulse/rewards/components/RedeemButton.tsx (client component):
     - Props: { catalogueItemId: string; pointsCost: number; userBalance: number }
     - Disabled if userBalance < pointsCost
     - On click: POST to /api/pulse/rewards/redeem with { catalogue_item_id }
     - On success: router.refresh() + toast.success('Redemption submitted!')
  c. src/features/pulse/rewards/components/RedemptionActions.tsx (client component):
     - Props: { redemptionId: string; onDone: () => void }
     - Approve / Reject buttons: PATCH to /api/pulse/rewards/redemptions/[id]
     - On done: router.refresh()
  d. src/app/(app)/pulse/rewards/page.tsx: `import RewardsPage from '@/features/pulse/rewards/components/RewardsPage'; export default RewardsPage;`

6. Add 'Rewards' to nav in src/lib/nav.ts:
  - In the 'Kazi Pulse' items array, add after 'Leaderboards':
    `{ href: '/pulse/rewards', icon: 'solar:gift-broken', label: 'Rewards' }`

7. Create milestones generate API route src/app/api/pulse/milestones/generate/route.ts (POST, CRON_SECRET protected):
  - Auth: Bearer CRON_SECRET check.
  - Fetch all active users with start_date: SELECT id, start_date, created_at FROM users WHERE is_active = true AND start_date IS NOT NULL.
  - For each user: compute anniversary date this year. If anniversary falls within next 7 days (today to today+6):
    - years_count = current year - year of start_date
    - Upsert into milestones (ON CONFLICT (user_id, type, milestone_date) DO NOTHING):
      { user_id, type: 'work_anniversary', milestone_date: anniversary ISO date, years_count }
  - For onboarding_complete: users created within last 30 days who have at least 1 checkin:
    - SELECT u.id FROM users u WHERE u.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM checkins c WHERE c.user_id = u.id)
    - Upsert { user_id, type: 'onboarding_complete', milestone_date: today }
  - Return { ok: true, created: N }.

8. Create MilestonesWidget server component at src/features/pulse/dashboard/components/MilestonesWidget.tsx:
  - Fetch next 5 upcoming milestones: SELECT m.id, m.user_id, m.type, m.milestone_date, m.years_count, u.name FROM milestones m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.milestone_date >= today ORDER BY m.milestone_date ASC LIMIT 5
  - Use supabaseAdmin; compute days until each milestone.
  - Render as a card section (same rounded-2xl border pattern as PulseDashboard sections):
    - Header: 'Upcoming milestones' with solar:confetti-broken icon
    - Each row: type icon (solar:calendar-mark-broken for anniversary, solar:gift-broken for birthday, solar:star-broken for achievement), staff name, milestone label, days until badge
    - Empty state if none
  - This is a server component (async function) — no 'use client'.
  - Import and render MilestonesWidget inside PulseDashboard.tsx, for managers only (if isManager): add it after the team radar section.

9. Create automation rules API route src/app/api/pulse/automations/run/route.ts (POST, CRON_SECRET protected):
  - Auth: Bearer CRON_SECRET check.
  - Fetch active automation rules: SELECT * FROM automation_rules WHERE is_active = true
  - For each rule:
    - trigger_type === 'milestone_anniversary' + action_type === 'send_notification':
      Find milestones where milestone_date = today and type = 'work_anniversary'.
      For each, call notifyMilestone(milestone.user_id, 'work_anniversary', milestone.years_count ?? undefined).
    - trigger_type === 'campaign_start' + action_type === 'send_notification':
      Find campaigns where starts_at::date = today and status IN ('upcoming','live').
      For each campaign, fetch all active users, call notifyCampaignLive(userId, campaign.name).
  - Return { ok: true, processed: N }.
  - Import notifyMilestone, notifyCampaignLive from src/lib/notifications.ts.

10. Create AutomationsClient.tsx in src/features/settings/components/:
  - Client component, Props: `{ initial: AutomationRule[]; userId: string }`
  - Lists active rules with toggle (is_active). On toggle: PATCH /api/pulse/automations/rules/[id] with { is_active }.
  - 'New rule' button opens SimpleModal with: trigger_type select + action_type select. On save: POST /api/pulse/automations/rules.
  - Rule display: trigger label + action label + active toggle badge.

11. Create src/app/api/pulse/automations/rules/route.ts (GET + POST) and src/app/api/pulse/automations/rules/[id]/route.ts (PATCH):
  - All require can(role, 'manage_automations').
  - GET: returns all automation_rules ordered by created_at desc.
  - POST: body { trigger_type, action_type, config? }. Validates types against allowed enum values. Inserts with created_by = session.user.id.
  - PATCH [id]: body { is_active?: boolean, config?: object }. Updates the rule.

12. Create src/features/settings/components/AutomationsPage.tsx (server component):
  - Guards with can(role, 'manage_automations'); redirects to /settings if not.
  - Fetches automation rules via supabaseAdmin.
  - Renders SetPageHeader + AutomationsClient.

14. Add 'Automations' to SETTINGS_NAV in SettingsShell.tsx under 'Organization' group:
  `{ id: 'automations', label: 'Automations', icon: 'solar:bolt-circle-broken', href: '/settings/automations' }`
acceptance_criteria: Rewards nav item appears in src/lib/nav.ts Kazi Pulse group
MilestonesWidget server component exists in src/features/pulse/dashboard/components/
AutomationsClient.tsx and AutomationsPage.tsx exist in src/features/settings/components/
Automations nav entry added to SETTINGS_NAV
